rec.name: Universal Header with Separate Mobile & Desktop Menu
rec.status: Built — delivered (source code zip + docs); theme-integration instructions revised Oct 2025

what.text: A standalone, theme-independent header section (modelled on the Focal theme header) that lets the merchant assign one navigation menu for desktop and a different menu for the mobile drawer in the Theme Editor. If no mobile menu is chosen, it falls back to the main menu. The section also includes logo settings (desktop and mobile width, optional transparent logo on the homepage), sticky and transparent header options, header layout choices, a mega menu with a maximum of 4 images, search, account and cart icons with a cart count, and country and language selectors. The Focal theme already has the separate-menu setting; this ticket makes it reusable in other themes, tested on Dawn.

why.text: Mobile and desktop users navigate differently. Desktop has room for wide mega menus with many categories, while mobile needs a short, thumb-friendly list of the top categories. A tailored menu per device shortens the path to product and collection pages and reduces menu overload and bounce on mobile. It also lets the agency A/B test navigation structure per device without touching the other. This reasoning is inferred and was not stated in the ticket.

how.text: 1) Create a section file header.liquid in the target theme and paste the provided code, adapted from the Focal header. 2) Add the required translation keys (header.general.navigation, newsletter, login, account, cart, language, country) to locales/en.default.json. They must go inside the existing top-level JSON braces, not after the final closing bracket, or the file will throw a syntax error. 3) In the Theme Editor, open the Header group and, under Navigation, pick the 'Menu' (desktop) and the 'Mobile menu' (mobile drawer). The mobile menu falls back to the main menu if empty. 4) Configure layout, logo, sticky and transparent header, icons and selectors. The ticket's code file is truncated and has further steps (up to at least Step 8) that are not visible here, so the full build needs the original zip and doc.

items: Mobile menu (separate menu for the mobile drawer; falls back to the main menu if none selected)
Enable transparent header (homepage only) with transparent text colour and optional transparent logo
Logo image, desktop logo width, mobile logo width
Desktop layout (e.g. logo left with inline navigation, logo left with centered navigation, logo center with inline navigation, logo center with search open, drawer)
Show country selector / show language selector

dependencies.text: Needs the translation keys added to locales/en.default.json (a manual step that was reported to be error-prone for non-developers). The code assumes Focal-style snippets and CSS classes (e.g. 'desktop-menu', 'icon' snippets, custom elements like store-header, toggle-button, predictive-search-input, popover-content, cart-count) plus theme settings (header_background, header_text_color, cart_type, cart_icon). The developer reported it works on Dawn with the default search and cart, but other themes may need adjustments. Requires a mobile-menu drawer with id 'mobile-menu-drawer', plus search-drawer and mini-cart elements. No app is needed.

items: Menu link click-through rate by device
Mobile bounce rate and pages per session
Mobile conversion rate and revenue per session
Search usage rate (as an indicator of navigation friction)

images.caption: Theme Editor header settings: under Navigation there are two separate pickers, 'Menu' (Main menu) and 'Mobile menu' (Select). The mobile drawer on the left shows a shorter list (Shop, Merch, Brewing, Bundles, Über Uns). Red arrows mark the two settings.
Setup instruction (Step 8): add the header.general translation keys to en.default.json, inside the file's braces.
